mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.missionText: Providing authentic and distinguished Qur'anic education through an organized scientific and educational approach that combines memorization, revision, Tajweed, Qira'at, and foundational Islamic sciences, while nurturing the student's character.
mission.visionText: Leadership in teaching the Holy Qur'an and its sciences, preparing a generation that masters the Book of Allah, adheres to Islamic values, and is academically and educationally qualified to serve the Qur'an.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.summary: Enable complete memorization of the Qur'an, master recitation with Tajweed, qualify students for connected-chain Ijazah, teach Qur'anic Qira'at, instill proper understanding, develop academic aptitude, prepare qualified teachers, and embed Qur'anic ethics.

items.title: Enable Complete Memorization of the Qur'an
items.desc: Guiding students to memorize the entire Book of Allah with precision, retention, and structured milestones.

items.title: Master Recitation with Tajweed
items.desc: Perfecting phonetic articulation and applying both theoretical and practical rules of Tajweed.

items.title: Qualify Students for Connected-Chain Ijazah
items.desc: Preparing proficient memorizers for direct oral certification with an unbroken chain of transmission.

items.title: Teach Qur'anic Qira'at
items.desc: Instructing students in the foundational principles and variations of authentic Qur'anic recitations.

items.title: Instill Proper Understanding
items.desc: Connecting memorization with sound comprehension of Qur'anic meanings and Sharia sciences.

items.title: Develop Academic Aptitude
items.desc: Building strong scholarly foundations through classical texts and disciplined study.

items.title: Prepare Qualified Teachers
items.desc: Training and certifying skilled reciters and instructors capable of leading Qur'anic circles.

items.title: Embed Qur'anic Ethics
items.desc: Nurturing Islamic manners, noble character, and spiritual devotion inspired by the Holy Qur'an.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything international students usually ask before joining. Can't find your answer? Message us directly.

items.a: Online students study live with a qualified teacher. After you contact us on WhatsApp, we assess your level and goals and agree on a schedule that suits your time zone. Your teacher then follows your memorization and revision closely, just as with in-person students.

items.q: Are classes held via Zoom or WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. Lessons take place over live video calls, typically on Zoom or WhatsApp, depending on what works best for you. All you need is a stable internet connection and a device with a camera and microphone.

items.q: Do I need prior knowledge of Arabic?
items.a: No. Beginners start with the Foundational Literacy stage, learning the Arabic letters and phonetic spelling (Tahajji) step by step before moving on to memorization. Contact us to discuss support in your language.

items.q: Can I study in person in Mauritania?
items.a: Yes. The Mahdara is located in Toujounine, Administrative District, Mauritania. Contact us on WhatsApp to learn about in-person enrollment.
Yes. The Mahdara is licensed by the Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education under License No. 000057, issued on February 14, 2018.
Simply send us a message on WhatsApp. Our team will answer your questions and guide you through registration step by step.

visa.title: Mauritania E-Visa & Entry Guide
visa.subtitle: All international students must obtain an official Mauritanian E-Visa online before boarding their flight to Nouakchott.
visa.requirements_desc: Have these digital files ready before filling out the official ANRPTS government form:
visa.req_passport_desc: Clear scan of your passport bio page (must be valid for at least 6 months).
visa.req_photo_desc: Recent digital passport-style photograph with a plain white background.
visa.req_accommodation_desc: Address in Toujounine, Nouakchott & invitation/enrollment confirmation from the Mahdara.
visa.req_ticket_desc: Flight booking details arriving at Nouakchott–Oumtounsy International Airport (NKC).
visa.support_desc: Contact our administration on WhatsApp before applying. We will provide our official licensed school details (License No. 000057) and Toujounine address for your application.
visa.step1_desc: Confirm your arrival window via WhatsApp and receive the school's official address details.
visa.step2_desc: Complete the application on the official Mauritanian ANRPTS portal (anrpts.gov.mr).
visa.step3_desc: Once approved via email, print a physical copy of the E-Visa document to show your airline.
visa.step4_desc: Complete biometrics at Nouakchott Airport. Once settled, the school assists long-term students with local extensions.
visa.fee_note_desc: Airlines require a printed copy of your E-Visa to board. Keep crisp cash (~$60 USD or €55 EUR) ready to pay the biometric visa fee upon landing at Nouakchott Airport.
